newsitem.title: UK: Methven's sets first day premium on AIM.
newsitem.headline: Methven's sets first day premium on AIM.

text.p: Shares in book retailer Methven's Plc set a premium on Tuesday on their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
The shares were quoted at 48p by 0856 GMT, a four pence premium on the issue price of 44p. Dealers estimated 70,000 shares had been traded.
The company raised 1.2 million stg before expenses from the flotation, designed to fund expansion and was valued at 3.5 million stg at the issue price.
Methven's currently owns four bookshops at St. Alban's, Windsor, Woking and Worthing in south-east England.
